messages.subject: Re: ubuntu server - some problems and where to find directory
parts:
Please be more specific about what exactly didn't work. If the browser said it couldn't connect to the server, then it may be that port 3838 is not open on your router or not being forwarded to your machine. See http://portforward.com/english/routers/port_forwarding/ for a guide on how to forward port 3838.

Any Shiny apps that you want to serve should be placed in (a subdirectory of) /var/shiny-server/www/.
